newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC /China Light up at open.
newsitem.headline: CITIC /China Light up at open.

text.p: Shares in CITIC Pacific Ltd and China Light and Power Co Ltd resumed trade on Wednesday, with CITIC rising HK$0.50 to HK$40.00 and China Light up HK$0.30 to HK$34.00.
CITIC Pacific later shed its early gains to fall HK$0.30 to HK$39.20 while China Light shares forged ahead, rising HK$2.20 to HK$35.90.
CITIC Pacific said on Tuesday it would acquire 497.66 million new China Light shares at HK$32.66 each, representing a 20 percent stake in China Light's enlarged share capital.
"The main focus for CITIC is how are they going to finance this deal. This purchase is going to be very material," said Edward Chan, head of research at Amsteel Securities.
CITIC said on Tuesday that the HK$16.25 billion purchase would be financed out of internal resources and bank borrowings.

"If they finance this latest acquisition with borrowings, then I think the gearing will increase quite sharply, posssibly to about 90 percent," said Chan, adding that CITIC's gearing was currently at about 30 percent.
He said CITIC could also place shares or sell its eight percent Hongkong Telecom stake to fund the purchase.
However, analysts saw China Light gaining from CITIC Pacific's connections in China.
CITIC Pacific is the Hong Kong-listed arm of China's powerful state trading giant China International Trust and Investment Corp.
"People are quite optimistic about the potential to get into some China projects with the help of CITIC Pacific," said Chan.
